# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old (at the time of Anne's arrival)  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c3 P30](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0030)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew was an odd-looking, ungainly man with a stooping posture and long iron-gray hair touching his shoulders. Ever since the age of twenty, he had worn a full, soft brown beard. When going among strangers or traveling, he occasionally wore a white collar and dressed up in his best clothes.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c21 P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031)_

## Personality

Extremely shy, quiet, and bashful, Matthew hated being among strangers or talking to women and little girls. He was a patient, good-natured, and sympathetic listener who enjoyed talkative people as long as they did not expect him to speak. Highly indulgent toward Anne, he held fast to his opinions with quiet, silent persistency. He disliked excitement and was reluctant to discipline children, preferring to leave bringing up Anne to Marilla.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c10 P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003), [v1 c13 P6](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0006), [v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c27 P4](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0004), [v1 c30 P38](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0038)_

## Goals

- To keep Anne Shirley at Green Gables and give her a good home and education  <sub>[v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>
- To ensure Anne has nice, fashionable clothes like other girls  <sub>[v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at Green Gables with his sister Marilla. In his sixties, troubled by heart problems and needing help with farm work, he agreed with Marilla to adopt a boy from an asylum. Upon driving to Bright River station, he met Anne Shirley instead due to a mistake. Despite his lifelong dread of little girls, Matthew was immediately charmed by Anne's chatter and advocated keeping her at Green Gables. Over the following years, he became Anne's devoted friend and spoiled her, even braving his shyness to get her a fashionable puffed-sleeve dress and organdy gowns. His heart spells grew more frequent, requiring him to avoid excitement and heavy labor. Shortly after Anne completed her Queen's exam studies, Matthew read a newspaper report about the failure of the Abbey Bank, suffered a fatal sudden shock, and died instantly on the porch threshold. He was buried in Avonlea, where Anne continued visiting his grave weekly.

## Background by volume

- Grew up in the homestead built far from the main road by his shy father  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Remained shy and rarely left home throughout his life  <sub>[v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004)</sub>
- Wore a full, soft brown beard continuously since age twenty  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
